name: Pegasus Dwarf Irregular
tagline: DDO 216 — a gas-rich Local Group irregular, slow-burning and chemically primitive.
history: The Pegasus dwarf irregular (DDO 216) is a small gas-rich galaxy on the Local Group's fringe — a low-mass system that has converted only a small fraction of its gas into stars over cosmic time. Its chemical poverty makes it resemble the primordial dwarfs that must have populated the early universe. It sits close enough to Andromeda that its future may include capture, but for now it evolves as a free member of the group.
